nuggets.text: Bears coach Casey Woods played wide receiver and holder at Tennessee, appearing in 41 games from 2003-07.
Casey Woods was on Auburn's staff for the 2010 BCS national champions, one of two title-game teams he has coached.
Casey Woods got encouragement from his former mentor, Gus Malzahn, before his first game as the Bears' head coach.
The Bears' fight song is called "The Scotsman."
Basketball player Michael Osei-Bonsu played his first organized football game returning kicks for the Bears in the opener.
The Bears climbed as high as No. 2 in the national rankings in October 1990.
In the only prior Bears-Lions game, in 2024, Bears QB Jacob Clark completed 28 of 33 passes for 302 yards.
Coach Casey Woods calls Lindenwood the Bears' only in-state opponent of the 2026 season.
The Bears' school was named Southwest Missouri State until 2005.
The Bears have played at Plaster Stadium since 1941; it was called Briggs Stadium until a 1991 renovation.
